newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam bourse plans swift switch to euro.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam bourse plans swift switch to euro.

text.p: The Amsterdam stock and option exchanges will move to conduct all business in euros as soon as possible after the advent of the single European currency, the Dutch bourse said on Wednesday.

"Amsterdam Exchanges has the intention to move once and completely from the guilder to the euro at the earliest possible date, according to expectations January 4, 1999," the bourse said in a statement.
"This includes the trading systems, clearing and payments," it said.
"The big banks have stated that they will be able to offer sharedealing clients the choice of a guilder or a euro account right from the beginning," the bourse added.
"Amsterdam Exchanges has set up an organising committee as well as a project management team to...ensure a problem-free transition," it said.
Amsterdam Exchanges was formed by the merger of the European Options Exchange and the Amsterdam Stock Exchange at the start of this year.
